mark: Its render-and-tokenize bench on the image: gain beyond the interval, identical `tokens_sha256`
host: sp8 (spark-0016, NVIDIA GB10, Grace), --cpuset-cpus=5-9,15-19 as in the PR
evidence: README's A/B: bench_chat_template_multiturn.py --iters 8 on 1107 (baseline) and on the candidate image, boot1 then boot2, alternating images as in the README; plus the README's 7-file unit/contract pytest on the candidate image, two boots. The patched-file bind mounts are dropped because the candidate image carries 0771

measured.tokens_sha256: identical across all 4 runs (1107 x2, candidate-48 x2) in all 8 scenarios, and equal to the PR's prefixes: baccd4201d8c, 3c146c4aa9ed, 97a032f32afb, 02b371ce8e53, ba167fe3da8a, fd4a03f054c9, 5e7cc508dc6c, 96ddc572772c
measured.interval: two boots per image; mean +/- half-range of the two boots' 8-iteration means. Every cold and incremental e2e gain is beyond both intervals

anomalies: parse_chat_messages at 500 turns / user_every 50 / ctrl=True is SLOWER by mean on the candidate (16.656 +/- 0.041 ms vs 1107 3.115 +/- 0.034 ms) in both boots. It is one iteration of 8: max 122.448 / 123.661 ms, median 1.509 / 1.411 ms against 1107's median 3.04 ms

cold_e2e at 250 turns / user_every 50 carries the same kind of single outlier on the candidate (max 149.255 / 158.207 ms, median 24.906 / 24.197 ms), which is why its mean speedup (5.22x) is below its neighbours'

One-iteration outliers of 120-220 ms at fixed scenario positions also appear in 1107's runs (500t_ue50_ctrl render_only, max 199.8 / 219.0 ms) and in the PR's own receipts (candidate 250t_ue50 incremental_e2e, max 135.8 / 128.1 ms), so they look like a deterministic Python pause, not a regression of this patch; the bench reports means over 8 iterations, so one pause moves a cell

parts.part: render-and-tokenize bench: gain beyond the interval
parts.detail: cold e2e 4.21x-10.66x and incremental e2e 9.75x-34.35x faster than 1107 in all 8 scenarios, each beyond both images' boot intervals; render_only 6.95x-23.67x
all 8 scenarios, all 4 runs, equal to the PR's hashes

verdict_scope: fully evaluable on sp8 (host-side CPU bench)
reason: On the integrated image the PR's bench reproduces its gains against 1107 measured on the same host the same day, beyond the two-boot interval in every e2e cell, with bit-identical token IDs, and its 413-test suite passes on both boots. The one stage that is worse by mean (parse at 500 turns with control spellings) is a single-iteration pause; its median improves 2x.
notes: commands.txt start_utc is when the command was issued and includes any wait on /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock
sp8 load average was 3.3-5.6 during these runs (other agents' CPU jobs, unpinned); the benches were pinned to CPUs 5-9,15-19
bench-analysis.json is derived from the four bench JSONs by a973.py
